name: MUNI
title: MUNI
description:
The UNOFFICIAL Municipally-Owned Utility (MUNI) certified electric service area boundaries geospatial data layer has been created to display the geographic extent that utilities deliver electricity. The official certified electric service area boundaries are on file as county mylar maps and are available upon request at Public Utility Commission of Texas (PUCT) Central Records. Any amendments to those boundaries since the mylar maps were retired in the 1970's are recorded in PUCT Dockets.

Unless otherwise noted, data was submitted by the electric utilities; Data edited by Public Utility Commission of Texas (PUCT) Infrastructure Staff Gary Horton (GIS Specialist) and Reginald Tuvilla (Electric Infrastructure Analyst) on July 22, 2020; Data delivered to the PUCT by Miguel Pavon, who had been working with ongoing edits to service area boundaries at TxGIO (formerly TNRIS); Original data source Platts.
